SELECT p1.bill_id, p1.attempt as attempt1, p1.ts as ts1, p1.tender, p1.amount_inr, p1.till_status as status1,
       p2.attempt as attempt2, p2.ts as ts2, p2.till_status as status2
FROM payments.pos_payments p1
JOIN payments.pos_payments p2 ON p1.bill_id = p2.bill_id

LIMIT 20;
